web-guide-idea-71.audience: Small-business owners making their own promotional materials.
web-guide-idea-71.offer: Guide a simple menu or offer poster that participants can update later. Explain hierarchy and readability before decoration.
web-guide-idea-71.steps.0: Ask participants to bring product text and photos.
web-guide-idea-71.steps.2: Review each result and demonstrate how to change the next offer.
web-guide-idea-71.equipment: A phone with a design app can work; a laptop gives more room. Use existing product photos.
web-guide-idea-71.returnReason: Run later workshops for another useful format such as a catalogue cover or festival announcement.
web-guide-idea-71.promotion: Share an original sample design and list what attendees should prepare.

web-guide-idea-71.metadataDescription: Help a group of business owners create a menu, offer poster or social post during the session. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
